features: Upto 32 dB Active Noise Cancellation: Nirvana Ion ANC pioneers with up to 32 dB Active Noise Cancellation, silencing the world around you. Immerse yourself in pure audio bliss, free from the disturbances of the outside world, and experience a level of serenity that redefines your listening environment.

120 Hours Playback: Experience uninterrupted listening like never before as each Nirvana Ion ANC earbud boasts an industry-leading 24 hours of playback, with a total of 120 Hours setting new standards in audio longevity.
Crystal Bionic Sound : Get the best sound with Nirvana Ion ANC’s Crystal Bionic Sound powered by HiFi DSP, which delivers flawless sound optimisation for an exceptional listening experience.

Dual EQ Modes (Bass & Balanced): Nirvana Ion ANC features Dual EQ Modes, allowing you to customise your audio based on your mood. Choose between boAt Balanced Sound for unparalleled immersion or boAt Signature Sound for a reimagined audio adventure.

Supreme Calling Clarity : Powered by ENx Technology with Quad Mics, Nirvana Ion ANC ensures top-tier calling clarity by suppressing ambient noise that delivers your message distraction-free, regardless of your location.

BEAST Mode: Get into gaming with BEAST Mode, offering a remarkable 60 ms low latency. Nirvana Ion ANC guarantees synchronised entertainment that gives you an additional edge over others during the game. Seamless In-ear Detection & Patented Design: Nirvana Ion ANC incorporates in-ear detection for automatic play and pause functionality. The patented design & compact size ensures easy portability, allowing you to carry your music everywhere effortlessly.
